_comment: Register person-GUIDs that must NOT share a slug with a same-named peer. The officials slug is slugify(name, institution), which is unique only while `institution` names a specific body. For much of the register it does not — 2,538 declarants sit under the group label 'Училища', 1,712 under 'Детски градини', 978 under 'Процедури по ЗОП' — so two different people with the same legal name in the same group collapse onto one slug, and their filings merge into one profile that publishes neither person's wealth correctly. Every GUID listed here is re-slugged with the GUID folded into the disambiguator, which separates it from the peer that keeps the bare slug. Keyed on the GUID rather than the slug because the GUID is the register's own per-person identity and is stable across a declarant's filings. Same discipline as scripts/officials/_aliases.json: an explicit, reviewable table rather than a heuristic. scripts/officials/index.ts warns when it meets a collision that is NOT listed here, so a new one surfaces on the next ingest instead of silently merging.
_whatBelongsHere: ONLY a GUID proven to be a SECOND PERSON. This list is destructive in the other direction: a GUID listed by mistake splits ONE person's history into two profiles, each publishing part of their wealth. That is not hypothetical — 67 of the 72 entries this file once held were mistakes, and they left the ombudsman Диана Ковачева with four profiles (one per 2020 filing) and Петко Салчев with six. Two causes, both now handled: (a) 66 were not person ids at all but per-DOCUMENT guids from the bare-guid filenames the register emitted in 2019-2023 — scripts/officials/slug_identity.ts no longer reads those as an identity; (b) one (943A7E38…, Весела Караиванова-Начева, подуправител на НОИ) was a genuine person id, but the only one on that name — the peer it was 'separated' from was a document id. The remaining 7 are real: same legal name, same group label, and — the check that actually decides it — a different employer in `<Personal><Work>`. Per-GUID evidence for the ones added since is in `_evidence` below; add an entry there whenever you add a GUID.
_howToAdd: Run the ingest. A 'slug collision' warning names the slug and prints, per competing GUID, one declaration URL and a 'работи:' line — the declarant's EMPLOYER, read from `<Personal><Work>` in the filing itself. Read the employers first: the group label the slug is built from ('Училища', 'Процедури по ЗОП') is shared by hundreds, while <Work> names the actual school/court/unit and in practice settles the case outright. Two different employers → two people. The SAME employer proves nothing on its own, so fall back to OPENING BOTH URLs and comparing the declared property/income: identical holdings mean ONE person whose id the register re-issued between folders (it does: Николай Стефанов Петров filed under FBEA081E… in 2014 and 68B238E8… in 2016 with the same house, flat and loan) — change nothing, the merge is already correct. Only when it is genuinely two people: add the SECOND and subsequent GUIDs (leave one out — that person keeps the bare slug, so prefer to leave the one that filed FIRST, whose slug is already published) and re-run. Do not add a GUID on the strength of the warning alone. Beware one trap the holdings comparison alone walks into: a 'Vacate' filing legitimately declares less than an 'Annualy' one, so 'disjoint holdings' across those two types is weak evidence — 6% of declarants who file both leave the Vacate's property table empty. The employer line is what resolves those.

_evidence.D1245F3F-A206-40F9-BB6C-A9F0BE3D1D09: Иван Стоянов Стоянов, Процедури по ЗОП — shared ivan-stoyanov-stoyanov-5d97ce with A0555741…, who keeps the bare slug (3 of the 4 filings, and the published one since 2019). Employers settle it: A0555741 is <Work>Окръжна прокуратура - Хасково</Work>, административен ръководител-окръжен прокурор; D1245F3F is <Work>ВОЕННО ФОРМИРОВАНИЕ 26720 - ЧЕРНОМОРЕЦ</Work>, командир на дивизион. The property agrees and is fully disjoint — Пловдив/Хасково flats, garages and two mortgages against Бургас/Ружица/Болярово/Стефан Караджово flats, house, vila and arable land — with no parcel, share fraction or debt in common.
_evidence.2E6D233C-AFD8-4BDA-B190-F4BCB38210A7: Иван Георгиев Иванов, Училища — shared ivan-georgiev-ivanov-b85a89 with EDDF7B29…, who keeps the bare slug (filed 2024-05-14 against 2024-06-18, and still in post: he filed an Annualy for 2025 too). Two directors of two different schools: EDDF7B29 is <Work>ОУ " Климент Охридски"</Work>, 2E6D233C is <Work>ОУ' Д-Р ПЕТЪР БЕРОН"</Work>. The holdings alone would NOT have carried this one — 2E6D233C's filing is a Vacate with an empty property table, which is a legitimate shape for that type — which is exactly why the employer line was added to the report. Listing it also unblocks the EDDF7B29 fork parked in ./_declarant_guid_aliases.json `_notListed`.
